data.Name: After the Storm
data.Description: The storms have passed but the damage remains — gather supplies for the survivors
data.Template_Text: The Storm Caller is defeated, but the devastation is everywhere. [NPC1] rallies the survivors near [Location1] and begs you to scavenge for [Junk1] — building materials, food, anything to help the villagers piece their lives back together.
data.2nd_state_Template_Text: With the [Junk1] you gathered, [NPC1] and the villagers near [Location1] begin rebuilding. Shelters go up, fires are lit, and for the first time since the storms began, there's hope. You've earned every scrap of gratitude they can muster.
